threads.body: Removing GEN_AI_USAGE_CACHE_CREATION_INPUT_TOKENS / GEN_AI_USAGE_CACHE_READ_INPUT_TOKENS from a non-underscore module is a potentially breaking change for any downstream code importing them, even though the instrumentation no longer needs them internally. Consider keeping them as backward-compatible aliases to the semconv constants (optionally with a short deprecation note) so external imports don’t break.
